name: Google Search Console
summary: Reads your Google search clicks, impressions, top searches and top pages for each site every 6 hours.

settings.label: Sites, separated by commas, exactly as Search Console lists them (for example sc-domain:example.com, https://www.example.com/)
Service account key (JSON) from Google Cloud → IAM → Service accounts → Keys; add the account's email as a user of each site in Search Console → Settings → Users and permissions
